_comment: The helm is back in this tag, and signing the articles no longer touches anybody's profession. Being in this tag is what sends an unemployed villager hunting for a workstation, so this is the ONLY thing that makes a Crewman: a villager walks to a wheel and takes the job. Sneak+C is now purely the roster -- which is what lets a blacksmith or a librarian sail as crew while keeping their trade. Known cost, and the reason it was removed once before: a helm carries crewmanHelmPoiTickets (64 by default) against an ordinary bench's one, so it is the most claimable job site for a long way in every direction and will out-hire nearby benches. Both the ticket count and crewmanHelmPoiRange are config, and they are the dials to turn if it starts hiring villagers who were wanted elsewhere.
